title: Wavefront angle expression
description: Essential: Correctly expresses φ as arcsin(1/(βn)) or equivalent.

title: Minimum pressure calculations
description: Essential: Correctly calculates P_min for protons, kaons, and pions (16 atm, 4.6 atm, 0.36 atm).

title: Halved radius pressure and angles
description: Essential: Correctly finds P_1/2 = 6 atm, θ_κ ≈ 1.6°, θ_π ≈ 3.2°, and states protons do not radiate.

title: Derivation of Δθ/Δp relation
description: Important: Applies logarithmic differentiation or small-angle approximation to relate Δθ to Δp via β.

title: Momentum spread for distinguishability
description: Important: Correctly sets up and solves θ_π - θ_κ > 10(Δθ_κ + Δθ_π) to find Δp < 0.3 GeV/c.

title: Minimum kinetic energy formula
description: Important: Derives T_min = Mc²(γ_min - 1) with γ_min = n/√(n² - 1) or equivalent.

title: Particle identification in water
description: Important: Calculates T_min for α and β particles and correctly identifies electrons as the source.

title: Dispersion and momentum broadening
description: Optional: Correctly calculates δθ from refractive index variation and Δθ from given Δp.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in logarithmic differentiation or misplaces factors of c in relativistic formulas.

title: Approximation misuse
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applies small-angle or small-(n-1) approximations outside their validity.
